title: Order Values and Denominations Across the Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Range
content:
Every Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order carries one value in US dollars. That value must lie between the product's smallest and largest order value, both inclusive of the figures shown. Products sold in fixed denominations accept only one of the listed values; products sold in an open range accept any value between the smallest and the largest.

| Product | How values are offered | Fixed denominations (USD) | Smallest order value | Largest order value |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | open range | none | $1.00 | $100.00 |
| Paloma Data Bundle | fixed denominations | $3.00, $5.00, $10.00, $15.00, $25.00 | $3.00 | $25.00 |
| Paloma Electricity Token | open range | none | $5.00 | $300.00 |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | open range | none | $5.00 | $1500.00 |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | fixed denominations | $5.00, $10.00, $15.00, $25.00, $40.00 | $5.00 | $40.00 |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | open range | none | $20.00 | $5000.00 |

## Points of judgement

**An open-range product.** Any value from the smallest to the largest figure is acceptable. A Paloma Electricity Token order of $5.00 or of $300.00 sits on the range; $4.99 is below it and $300.01 is above it.

**A fixed-denomination product.** The value must be one of the listed denominations and must also lie in the range. A Paloma Data Bundle order of $10.00 is acceptable; a Paloma Data Bundle order of $12.00 lies inside the $3.00 to $25.00 range but is not one of the listed denominations, so it is not an acceptable value.

**Television packages.** Paloma Bill Pay Television is sold in fixed denominations of $5.00, $10.00, $15.00, $25.00 and $40.00 only; a $20.00 Paloma Bill Pay Television order is not an acceptable value.

The figures above are order values in US dollars, before any service fee or card funding fee.
